content.short: HeyElsa AI is an AI-powered crypto co-pilot that simplifies on-chain actions.
content.description: Crypto remains complex, with wallets, bridges, gas fees, and chain nuances creating barriers to even simple DeFi tasks. HeyElsa AI acts as a smart on-chain assistant, letting you state your goal in plain language or with voice input—for example, 'Send $50 to raj.basename.eth on Base'—and the AI takes care of the rest. It orchestrates wallet routing, cross-chain transfers, swaps, transaction signing, and risk checks across Base, Solana, Ethereum, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Polygon, OP Mainnet, and Fantom.
